#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [ "$#" -lt 1 ]; then echo 'Usage: bash run-on-board.sh /absolute/path/to/lab-st-2026 [--touch event-path] [--two-player]' >&2; exit 2; fi
project_dir=$(realpath -- "$1")
shift
tool_dir=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
check_options=()
remaining=("$@")
for ((i=0;i<${#remaining[@]};i++)); do
    if [ "${remaining[$i]}" = --touch ]; then
        if ((i+1>=${#remaining[@]})); then echo 'Missing touch path' >&2;exit 2;fi
        check_options+=(--touch "${remaining[$((i+1))]}");i=$((i+1))
    fi
done
python3 "$tool_dir/preflight.py" --project "$project_dir" "${check_options[@]}"
record_dir=$(mktemp -d "$project_dir/run-gomoku-XXXXXX")
cd -- "$project_dir/out"
echo "Log: $record_dir/run.log"
set +e
./lab6_gomoku "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$record_dir/run.log"
status=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e
printf '\nProgram exit status: %d\n' "$status" | tee -a "$record_dir/run.log"
exit "$status"

"""Windows host checks and simulated framebuffer previews; no board connection."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, re, struct, subprocess
from PIL import Image, ImageFont

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--cc',required=True);args=parser.parse_args()
compiler=Path(args.cc).resolve(strict=True)
build=ROOT/'build';results=ROOT/'test-results';assets=build/'assets';preview=ROOT/'preview'
for directory in (build,results,assets,preview):directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
env=dict(os.environ);env['PATH']=str(compiler.parent)+os.pathsep+env.get('PATH','')

def run(command,log):
    result=subprocess.run(list(map(str,command)),cwd=ROOT,env=env,capture_output=True,
                          encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=60)
    output=result.stdout+result.stderr
    (results/log).write_text(output,encoding='utf-8')
    if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError(f'{log}: exit {result.returncode}\n{output}')
    if output:print(output.rstrip())
    return output

flags=['-std=gnu11','-O3','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-Wno-unused-parameter',
       '-static','-I',build,'-I',ROOT/'common','-I',ROOT/'lab6_gomoku','-I',ROOT/'tests']
engine=[ROOT/'lab6_gomoku'/name for name in ('gomoku.c','ai.c','app.c')]
run([compiler,*flags,ROOT/'tests/test_game.c',*engine,'-o',build/'test_game.exe'],'game-compile.log')
game_output=run([build/'test_game.exe'],'game.log')

source=(ROOT/'common/graphic.c').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
globals=source[source.index('static int LCD_FB_FD;'):source.index('void fb_init(')]
globals=globals.replace('static int LCD_FB_FD;\n','').replace('static int DRAW_BUF[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT];',
    'static struct { int before[GUARD_WORDS]; int pixels[SCREEN_WIDTH*SCREEN_HEIGHT]; int after[GUARD_WORDS]; } TEST_BACK;\n#define DRAW_BUF TEST_BACK.pixels')
core='#include "common.h"\n#include <limits.h>\n#include <math.h>\n#define GUARD_WORDS 64\n'+globals+source[source.index('static void _copy_area('):]
(build/'graphics-under-test.c').write_text(core,encoding='utf-8')
image=(ROOT/'common/image.c').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
memory=image[image.index('/*w, h maybe == 0*/'):image.index('/*================== read a jpeg image')]
(build/'image-memory-under-test.c').write_text('#include <limits.h>\n'+memory,encoding='utf-8')
chars=set(''.join(chr(i) for i in range(32,127)))
for path in (ROOT/'lab6_gomoku').glob('*.c'):chars.update(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
font_path=ROOT.parent/'course-source/lab-st-2026/out/font.ttc'
for size in (20,24,30):
    font=ImageFont.truetype(str(font_path),size)
    for ch in sorted(c for c in chars if ord(c)>=32 and c not in '\r\n\t'):
        mask,offset=font.getmask2(ch,mode='L',anchor='ls')
        header=struct.pack('<iiiii',*mask.size,*offset,round(font.getlength(ch)))
        (assets/f'glyph-{ord(ch):x}-{size}.bin').write_bytes(header+bytes(mask))
run([compiler,*flags,ROOT/'tests/test_render.c',*engine,ROOT/'lab6_gomoku/render.c',
     ROOT/'tests/asset_adapter.c','-lm','-o',build/'test_render.exe'],'render-compile.log')
render_output=run([build/'test_render.exe'],'render.log')
for path in preview.glob('*.ppm'):Image.open(path).save(path.with_suffix('.png'))
run([compiler,*flags,'-DO_NONBLOCK=2048','-I',ROOT/'tests/host-headers','-fsyntax-only',
     ROOT/'lab6_gomoku/main.c',ROOT/'common/touch.c',ROOT/'common/touch_protocol.c'], 'host-syntax.log')
report={
    'mode':'Windows C rules/AI/app tests and simulated memory framebuffer',
    'compiler':str(compiler),'compilerFlags':'-O3 -Wall -Wextra -Werror',
    'ruleAIInputChecks':int(re.search(r'PASS: (\d+) checks',game_output)[1]),
    'uiStatesRendered':6,'guardedFramebufferChecksPassed':'PASS:' in render_output,
    'hostSyntaxChecksPassed':True,'hostSyntaxUsesLinuxAPIShims':True,'fontSimulation':'Pillow host masks, not native board FreeType',
    'nativeLinuxCompileValidated':False,'hardwareValidated':False,'TAaccepted':False,
    'pending':['Linux ARM build','Real touch mapping, responsiveness and display','Class acceptance'],
    'sourceHashes':{p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                    for folder in ('lab6_gomoku','common') for p in (ROOT/folder).glob('*') if p.is_file()}}
(results/'offline-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:report[k] for k in ('ruleAIInputChecks','uiStatesRendered','hardwareValidated')}))

"""Create a source overlay while preserving the already validated course common code."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast, hashlib, json, tarfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
previous=json.loads((ROOT.parent/'lab4-prepared/manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
prior={entry['path']:entry for entry in previous['files']}
files=[]
for folder in ('common','lab6_gomoku'):
    for path in sorted((ROOT/folder).glob('*')):
        if not path.is_file():continue
        relative=path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        old=prior.get(relative)
        if folder=='common':assert old and sha(path)==old['sha256'],relative
        files.append({'path':relative,'sha256':sha(path),
                      'allowedPreviousSHA256':old['allowedPreviousSHA256'] if old else []})
files.append({'path':'tests/test_game.c','sha256':sha(ROOT/'tests/test_game.c'),'allowedPreviousSHA256':[]})
manifest={'version':'2026-10-15-gomoku','courseHeaderSHA256':sha(ROOT/'common/common.h'),
          'files':files,'hardwareValidated':False,'target':'Orange Pi 4 LTS, Linux aarch64'}
(ROOT/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
report=json.loads((ROOT/'test-results/offline-result.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for relative,digest in report['sourceHashes'].items():assert sha(ROOT/relative)==digest,relative
for path in ROOT.rglob('*.py'):
    if 'build' not in path.relative_to(ROOT).parts:ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'),feature_version=(3,8))
for path in ROOT.rglob('*.sh'):assert b'\r' not in path.read_bytes(),path
members=[]
for path in sorted(ROOT.rglob('*')):
    if not path.is_file():continue
    relative=path.relative_to(ROOT)
    if relative.parts[0]=='build' or '__pycache__' in relative.parts or path.suffix in ('.pyc','.ppm'):continue
    members.append(relative)
archive_path=ROOT.parent/'lab6-gomoku-ready.tgz'
with tarfile.open(archive_path,'w:gz') as archive:
    for relative in members:archive.add(ROOT/relative,arcname=ROOT.name+'/'+relative.as_posix(),recursive=False)
with tarfile.open(archive_path,'r:gz') as archive:
    assert len(archive.getmembers())==len(members)
    for relative in members:assert archive.extractfile(ROOT.name+'/'+relative.as_posix()).read()==(ROOT/relative).read_bytes()
archive_path.with_name(archive_path.name+'.sha256').write_text(sha(archive_path)+'  '+archive_path.name+'\n',encoding='ascii')
print(f'PASS: source hashes, common-code preservation, Python 3.8 syntax, shell line endings and {len(members)} archive members')
print(f'Package: {archive_path.name} ({archive_path.stat().st_size} bytes)')
